analysis_steps.goal: Fit SED and ALMA data with physical disk model grid

method.value: Grid of D'Alessio irradiated accretion disk models with cavity in large grains; best SED fit by chi2; model images Fourier transformed, sampled at ALMA uv, cleaned and compared with visibilities and radial profile

evidence.quote: From the grid of parameters tested, the models that best fit the SED were obtained by minimizing the _χ_ [2] .

findings_qualitative.value: Small grains fill the cavity; the cavity exists only in large grains.

evidence.quote: Our detailed modeling of HD 142666 also indicates that no corresponding cavities exist in the small grains.

claims.hypothesis: Does the Group II disk HD 142666 have a cavity in large grains?
claims.experiment: Joint SED and ALMA visibility/image modeling with and without a large-grain cavity
claims.result: Full disk models fail; best fit has cavity out to 15.6 au
claims.finding: Group II disks can have cavities of large grains

evidence.quote: We found our best fit to the ALMA observations when including a cavity in the large dust grains out to 15.6 au.

claims.hypothesis: Is HD 142666 highly settled, consistent with Group II?
claims.finding: High degree of settling consistent with Group II

evidence.quote: which was consistent with the classification of HD 142666 as a Group II source.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Self-shadowing cannot explain the cavity since mm emission probes the midplane

evidence.quote: this cannot explain the cavity revealed by the ALMA observations since the radio emission probes dust in the midplane

limitations_admitted.value: Resolution insufficient to fully resolve the inner disk

evidence.quote: the ALMA observations did not have enough angular resolution to fully resolve the inner parts of the disk
